output.title: Indian shares seen lower as oil stays near six-month high, Fed in focus
output.summary: Indian shares are set to open lower on Tuesday, giving back some of the previous session's gains, as Brent crude prices remained near $115 a barrel and ​investors stayed cautious ahead of the US Federal Reserve's policy decision later ‌this week.
